description: 🔍 VERSION-SPECIFIC SOFTWARE AUDIT 🔍 Audit specific software versions for known vulnerabilities. Use this when you have exact software version information (e.g., Chrome 138.0.7204.184). NEVER use search_lucene for version-specific software audits.

body.description: Request body containing software list and audit parameters. Should include 'software' array with structured CPE objects (NOT CPE strings) and optional 'match' parameter ('partial' or 'full'). Each CPE object has the CPE 2.3 fields: part, vendor, product, version, update, edition, language, sw_edition, target_sw, target_hw, other; vendor, product and version are required. USE THIS for specific software versions like 'Chrome 138.0.7204.184'.

match.description: "partial" (API default) or "full"; use "full" with target_sw for OS-specific audits

software.description: Software to audit: structured CPE objects (preferred) or CPE 2.3 strings

anyOf.description: CPE 2.3 well-formed name, one field per WFN attribute.

target_sw.description: Target software, e.g. "windows" or "macos"; use "*" for any

name: audit_software
